info.description: Use only local demo. Select role by changing login credentials. Set IDs after creation. Mutations include reset/logout/retire; do not blindly Run All. Collection generated and route checked; not executed in Postman.

All authenticated roles. Required inclusive from/to dates, maximum 56 days. No exception reasons, drafts or booking contacts.

MEMBER: active approved PT public reviews; PT SELF; RECEPTIONIST, MANAGER, ADMIN ALL. Returns rating, optional comment, creation date and the generic reviewer label only. Never returns member/user/booking identifiers or contact information.

MEMBER. Required Idempotency-Key 8-100 characters. Same actor/key/payload replays original creation; changed payload is 409. Pending PT holds capacity until rejection/cancellation/expiry. Response deadline min(now+30 minutes, starts_at).
All authenticated roles. Member sees own bookings; PT assigned bookings; operators see all. No contact details.

MEMBER. Required Idempotency-Key 8-100 characters. The server orders the selected sessions and requires one room, one date and immediately consecutive times. All selected bookings commit together or none commit. Same actor/key/payload replays the original ordered array; changed payload is 409. Invalid or non-consecutive selections return 422.

All authenticated roles. Member self cancellation allowed at least two hours before start. Operators and assigned PT require reason. Pending PT should reject instead of cancel. Terminal transitions return 409.
All authenticated roles. Member SELF, PT ASSIGNED, operators ALL. Missing attendance is null; self-training has no PT participant.

ADMIN, MANAGER, RECEPTIONIST. Server infers participant and recorder. CONFIRMED only, starts_at-15min <= DB time < ends_at. Early override requires reason. First record 201, replay 200 preserves original record without extra audit; invalid window/participant 422. No additions after end; no normal cancellation after attendance.

MEMBER SELF. Only a member may review their own COMPLETED booking after its end, when an assigned PT and attendance records for both participants exist. One review per booking; no edit or delete operation.
All authenticated roles. Member SELF, assigned PT, and facility roles may read. data is null when no review exists; out-of-scope bookings return 404.

ADMIN or MANAGER. Inclusive Vietnam-local session_date range, default current month through today, at most 366 dates. Booking totals are current status at as_of and may include future sessions. Attendance and no-show metrics include ended sessions only. no_show is NO_SHOW / (COMPLETED + NO_SHOW), null for zero denominator. Utilization is booked seat-minutes for CONFIRMED/COMPLETED/NO_SHOW on ended OPEN sessions divided by capacity-minutes for those sessions; one booking consumes one seat regardless of PT attendance. It is reserved time, not measured workout time. Legacy ended bookings without confirmation/cancellation evidence are surfaced as unclassified. Invalid room ID returns 404; invalid date/filter returns 422.

PT SELF or ADMIN/MANAGER ALL. Inclusive Vietnam-local session_date range, default current month through today, at most 366 dates. Rating aggregates valid reviews on completed ended bookings in the selected range. Attendance uses ended confirmed COMPLETED/NO_SHOW bookings and confirmed MEMBER/PT cancellations per BR-22; FACILITY cancellations, REJECTED, EXPIRED and pending requests are excluded. Missing confirmation or UNKNOWN cancellation evidence is unclassified. Pending end-of-session CONFIRMED bookings are reported separately. A zero denominator or no reviews returns null rather than zero. PT can read only their own profile ID; managers/admins may read any existing PT. Other roles receive 403; out-of-scope or missing profile receives 404.
Public. AVAILABLE/MAINTENANCE only. Search at most 120 characters; explicit public projection, no management metadata.
Public. Only visible room covers; private trainer certificates remain authenticated. ETag is revalidated, including room visibility.

Public. Required YYYY-MM-DD range, at most seven inclusive days. Future-ending, published/legacy sessions only; aggregate remaining seats, no booking identities or personalized eligibility. No holds are made.
Public. APPROVED trainers with active PT accounts only. No username, contact details, certificate, absence or decision data.
